title: Humans Hallucinate Too: Language Models Identify and Correct Subjective Annotation Errors With Label-in-a-Haystack Prompts

live_model.evidence: "We use GPT-3.5 Turbo (gpt-3.5-turbo), GPT-4 (gpt-4-turbo), and GPT-4o (gpt-4o-mini), Llama-2 ... and Llama-3" (Sec. 4.2)

prompt.location: Appendix: LiaHR prompt with randomly retrieved in-context examples

claim.metric: p-value of reasonableness contingency (copy-correct items judged reasonable vs unreasonable)

data.source: SemEval-2018 Task 1 (E-c); annotator reasonableness labels in github.com/gchochla/liahr (unverified)

notes: GPT-4 numbers are contingency counts against human reasonableness annotations; GPT-4o is the main model. Version not printed; date rule.
